messages:
maria: Kickoff — quarterly access review for Payments & Billing (scope: payments-api, billing-worker, tokenizer-service). Need owners for any roles without rc_owner tag. I'll attach the owner map I pulled.

sam: quick Q — what's our acceptance criteria for 'ownerless'? last commit + 60d?

maria: yep: no owner tag OR owner not seen in last 90d => ownerless. Plan: notify owners, 72h to claim, then schedule removal in canary.

devon: can we automate notifications? I can wire up an ephemeral GH issue + slack reminder. I'd prefer we use access-lint check to gate PRs.

alice: flagged — KMS grants for billing-worker are bound to cross-account role arn:aws:iam::999999999:role/billing-deploy. CloudTrail shows recent assume failures: `AccessDenied` on Encrypt. Is that part of the cleanup or separate incident?

maria: good catch. Treat as vuln triage — not removing bindings until we verify. I've filed a vuln ticket. @sec-bot can you post recent KMS errors?

sec-bot: automated-scan: 5 KMS EncryptDenied events (billing-worker) in last 48h. See /alerts/KB-5123. :warning:

jordan: I'll take vuln triage. Steps: (1) validate service principals, (2) check cross-account IAM changes, (3) rotate key if compromised. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria: thanks @jordan. For the ownerless remediation, proposed playbook:
```
- run `./tools/access-export --service payments-api --format csv`
- post to #eng-security owners ping
- 72h claim window
- plan canary removal: disable role -> monitor 24h -> delete
```

sam: where do we store evidence for compliance? need artifact for auditors.

maria: upload to GCS retention bucket /security/access-reviews/q3-2025 and tag with review-id: ar-1754321987. Also archive the GH issues.

devon: FYI there's a small RBAC migration next week that will re-map 'payments-admin' -> 'payments-manager'. We should exclude mapping group from auto-deletion for 1 week post-migration.

maria: noted — add exclusion rule for group:payments-admin until 2025-06-10. @devon please add to the action queue.

jordan: assigned remediation tasks to @jordan, @devon; @alice do you want to own the KMS followup? 

alice: can do, taking KMS incident.

maria: final ask — volunteers for audit evidence review on Friday? need one reviewer. :eyes:

sam: I can review.

maria: perfect. I'll open the review doc and post link here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
